mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you noticed how artificial intelligence is popping up everywhere these days? It's not just changing the way we work, but the way we connect, create, and even think about what's possible. Now, imagine a world where AI isn't just another tool in your toolbox, but a true partner—one that helps you amplify your strengths, challenge what you thought you knew, and unlock new levels of creativity. That's exactly what Ethan Mollick invites us to explore in his book, Co-Intelligence: Living and Working with AI. Together, we're going to uncover how co-intelligence isn't about giving up control—it's about discovering how human intuition and machine logic can work hand-in-hand. We'll walk through real-life stories and practical strategies, learning how to thrive in a world that's rapidly evolving. How can you tap into AI's strengths, while still embracing your own unique perspective? What does it look like to build a future where people and intelligent systems grow and succeed, side by side? So, as we set out on this journey together, get ready to spark your curiosity, build resilience, and see just how much more we can achieve—when humans and AI join forces. Let's dive in and discover what co-intelligence truly means for all of us.
